data.title: The 2027 Tipping Point: Humanoid Robots on Campus
data.description: A very visible turning point is approaching in 2027, when we will see autonomous humanoid robots working with and engaging people on campus. They will have left the engineering research and development labs to begin making actual contributions “in person.”
